integration_issues.flow: Start a plan from a template
integration_issues.issue: The new plan is created but the template's slots/songs/games/snacks/materials/story.questions are ALL empty in the resulting plan. Only scalar fields like topic_title/memory_verse survive. Root cause: LessonPlanningPage.jsx openPlan() line 76 sends {event_id, template_id, slots: []} in the POST body. Backend create_plan() line 289 merges the request body over the template snapshot with `{k: v for k, v in data.items() if v not in (None, "")}` — the filter does NOT exclude empty lists, so the empty `slots: []` from the frontend clobbers the template's slots. In practice the user picks 'Standard Saturday kids club', gets a plan with just the topic and everything else blank — the whole point of templates. Reproduced twice; screenshot at /app/test_reports/pytest/ui_error.png-equivalent flow shows 'No slots yet — add the welcome, worship, story, games and snacks.' even though the template had 3 slots. Backend pytest didn't catch this because the pytest client posts `{event_id, template_id}` only, without `slots: []`.

action_items: FIX start-from-template regression: EITHER stop the frontend from posting `slots: []` (LessonPlanningPage.jsx openPlan line 76 — drop `slots: []` from the POST body when template_id is set, or drop it always) OR harden the backend filter at lesson_planning.py:289 to also skip empty lists/dicts (e.g. `if v not in (None, "") and v != [] and v != {}`). The backend fix is safer because it also protects future callers. Then add a regression test that POSTs `{event_id, template_id, slots: []}` and asserts slots is NOT wiped.

Consider tightening the frontend 'Save as template' dialog to show a visible red validation message when the name is empty or duplicate, so the user knows why the dialog stayed open (right now the toast fires but the dialog gives no inline hint).
critical_code_review_comments: lesson_planning.py create_plan line 289 uses a permissive merge (`if v not in (None, "")`) that lets empty lists/dicts overwrite template content — root cause of the start-from-template regression. Belongs in a helper and should have a unit test.
LessonPlanningPage.jsx has grown past 550 lines with the templates + email additions — still one file; splitting the plan editor and the dialogs into their own components would help.
Prior round's scoping notes (list_library / outreach_events / duplicate_plan target-campus check) have been addressed as promised.

rca of the issue: Start-from-template regression: user clicks lp-start-template-<id> → openPlan(ev, tplId) fires → POST /api/lesson-planning/plans body = {event_id, template_id, slots: []}. Server create_plan() loads the template snapshot then merges the request body over it with `if v not in (None, "")`; empty list `[]` passes the filter and overwrites template's slots. All other list fields (songs, games, snacks, materials, offering) survive only because the frontend body doesn't include them explicitly — but the slots array does. Fix at either end; recommended: harden backend filter to skip empty containers AND drop `slots: []` from the frontend POST when it's meaningless (fresh plan from template).
